note: NOTE: category_id is nature, elemental, or spiritual. A monster drops that category's materials and essence. Combat stats (hp, attack, defense, xp, respawn_s, aggression) are v0 placeholders tuned so a level-appropriate player kills a regular mob in about 3-5 basic skill hits (e.g. Power Strike 140%), bosses take about 1-2 minutes, and a same-level mob deals about 5-10% of player HP per hit after player defense. See combat_formulas for the math and a worked example (level 5 Warrior vs Meadow Boar). aggression: passive = waits to be hit; aggressive = attacks on sight. respawn_s is seconds after a kill, per map timer. Night Stump is the cursed night variant of Old Stump. v0.1.2: hp halved across the board after playtest (regular mobs now die in ~3-4 hits at parity). attack_type: melee = damage only on body contact; ranged = slow, visible, dodgeable projectile (Crow only in Meadows). v0.1.3: attack_min/max are the per-hit roll (≈0.75–1.25× the typical attack column); no second variance dice on mobs. XP ×0.72 (−28%) across the roster. v0.1.3b: `anim_speed` is a per-monster multiplier on walk/idle/flap frame rate and walk wobble (1 = the v0.1.2 rate; Crow stays at 1 because that looked fine; other mobs are 0.5, i.e. 2× slower). Walk anim also scales with actual move speed. Attack wind-up timing is unchanged.
